title: Appeals Effectuation Memorandum: Reversal Basis for Units Issued, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
For a denied authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** that is issued after reconsideration, the reversal sets the basis of the units issued.

## Records read

The patient's most recent reconsideration of the authorization: the latest case in **Appeals and Grievances**, by filing date, whose subject is the authorization; its decision; and whether a letter of medical necessity (the plan of care the reviewer reversed on) is among that case's documents.

## Rule

1. Where the most recent reconsideration of the authorization is decided overturned and a letter of medical necessity is on that case, the basis is the units requested, never more than the type's maximum units per authorization.
2. Where it is decided partially overturned, the basis is half of that figure (the units requested, never more than the maximum), rounded down.
3. Otherwise (decided overturned with no letter of medical necessity on the case) the basis is the lesser of the units requested, the type's default units authorized and the maximum.

## Truth table

| Decision of the most recent reconsideration | Letter of medical necessity on the case | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| decided overturned | yes | units requested, capped at the maximum |
| decided overturned | no | lesser of units requested, default units and maximum |
| decided partially overturned | yes or no | half of the units requested capped at the maximum, rounded down |

## Cases (hypothetical; type with 30 default units and a 120-unit maximum)

| Units requested | Decision | Letter on the case | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | decided overturned | yes | 50 |
| 150 | decided overturned | yes | 120 |
| 50 | decided partially overturned | no | 25 |
| 45 | decided partially overturned | yes | 22 |
| 50 | decided overturned | no | 30 |
